label: Work the catchment
worldEffect: Drums are rolled, filters are rinsed, and the tank comes up an inch.
description: M5 task T85. The first job in the game that produces water. Deliberately produces item.water-dirty, not item.water: the catchment collects, and somebody still has to boil or filter it. That is what turns the purify recipes from a free one-shot conversion into the base's recurring fuel/charcoal cost, and it is what makes a companion affordable at all — a resident drinks 1.20/day and one worked cycle banks 2.
